query: Watch this YouTube playlist and keep my strategy deck current as new videos are added.
rationale: Continuous playlist monitoring plus a registered target is a primary workflow.

query: Extract everything from every video in this playlist, including slides and demos. I do not want summaries.
rationale: Explicit video-complete spoken and visual evidence request.

query: Refresh the Agentic AI topic library and show which pages on our site are stale.
rationale: Topic refresh and target impact analysis.

query: Build a complete timestamped outline from all playlist content.
rationale: Exhaustive playlist outline is a primary output.

query: What did these research videos demonstrate about evaluation harnesses? Include on-screen evidence.
rationale: Evidence-grounded transcript and visual research query.

query: Play my YouTube music playlist while I work.
rationale: Playback and music-playlist management are outside research scope.

query: Build a responsive landing page that looks like YouTube.
rationale: A YouTube-style frontend is a site-building request, not content research.

query: Download this movie from YouTube for offline viewing.
rationale: Entertainment downloading is outside the evidence workflow.

query: Embed a YouTube player component in this React page.
rationale: Frontend video embedding does not require research ingestion.

query: Give me a one-paragraph summary of this video from the title only.
rationale: Title-only summary explicitly avoids the complete research workflow.

query: Organize my personal watch-later playlist by mood.
rationale: Consumer playlist organization is outside continuous topic intelligence.
